facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 2 February 2026 records Mauritania as having signed the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection on 26 February 2015.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 2 February 2026 records Mauritania as having ratified the Convention on 19 April 2023 and deposited the instrument on 9 May 2023.
